author: Rebecca_B

title: Great alternative to the guided tour
text:
We booked a self-guided tour through Seville.
The explanations for the individual sights were very easy to understand - as was the routing via the interactive map - so that the tour through Seville could be completed with ease.
The pace could be determined by oneself at any time. The time spent at the individual sights was also left up to each person.
An interruption for refreshment or a meal was also always possible.
We will do this for other cities as well.

title: My preference over group tours
text: Extremely great value for a tour you can go at your own pace. I found it very informative and I learned where I wanted to spend the remainder of my days in Sevilla.

title: Recommendation!
text: Despite AI, a good clear explanation! Nice that it has to be done in one day and in a fixed order! The photos, map, and text are handy! Even listen back in the apartment!
author: BettyDG59

title: Perfect
text: This is my fourth tour through Tourific and it was great. Everything is very well done: the content, the map, the functioning of the app. I love having full control over when I leave and how long I stay at each stop. I'm hooked on these tours so that now every time I travel, I check if Tourific has something available. Highly recommended!
author: JoeMMx

title: Seville walking tour
text: Very useful information about places.  Lot of walking as difficult to follow map as so many streets and alleys.  We took two days to complete which was best for us as weather was very very hot.  Guide had good voice
